TenantBearer.description: The configured learnstack realm's signed RS256 access token for learnstack-api, issued to learnstack-web. Authentication grants no membership or application permission.

NativeSessionSource.description: Separate server-to-server native-session credential. Never expose it to browser code or reuse the public forwarding secret. Bearer identity and trusted real-host provenance are also required.
NativeSessionSource.name: X-LearnStack-Native-Session-Secret

get.description: Authenticated host-backed read through the physical read-only pipeline. Returns only the validated actor UUID, resolved tenant/organization UUIDs and existing public site projection. Accepts no query parameters or client-selected identifiers. No response caching or validators.

400.description: validation_failed; no query parameters are accepted, and malformed or repeated assertion headers are refused.

401.description: unauthorized; present invalid or undecidable credentials on a known host. Bare Bearer challenge; no credential or provider details.

404.description: not_found for absent credentials, unknown hosts, membership refusals or missing host-backed authority; tenant_mismatch for authenticated host/claim or header disagreement, without disclosure.

405.description: method_not_allowed from routing after credential and host-backed authority admission; this operation admits GET only. Absent credentials remain masked as 404.

413.description: payload_too_large; the decoded body bound precedes host classification and authentication. Kestrel framing/backstop refusals may occur outside the application response policy and omit these headers/body.

429.description: rate_limited from early visitor/peer admission, validated-subject quota or subject-registry capacity.

get.description: Tenant administrative membership directory requiring current Tenant identity.membership.admin. Rechecks live membership, lifecycle and capability for every page; accepts HostAndClaim or confirmed ClaimAndMembership, including a platform host. Returns only membership/user/organization identifiers, status, contextual displayName and preferredLocale. Active/Suspended undeleted memberships only, ordered by membership UUID. No search, sorting, editing, provider data, grants or global profile. No-store; the MUST ReadSensitive audit row commits before any result is disclosed. This operation is not admitted by the native BFF caller.

parameters.description: Opaque canonical continuation bound to the actor, tenant, organization and operation; obtain it from pageInfo.nextCursor. Every page reauthorizes.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Positive page size, default 20; values above 100 are clamped to 100. Repeated, empty or unknown query parameters are refused.
parameters.name: limit

The central MUST security event names the admitted Membership and commits before an association witness is returned. This proves API admission, never cookie delivery. Ordinary refresh uses Off self/AccountSite reads and does not invoke this POST. No query or Idempotency-Key; empty JSON object only.
